problem_statement: An internal procedure label resembling an event can manufacture an iRules frame when a consumer reconstructs policy from its spelling. A memo without the selected event body can also reuse an unrelated procedure entry.
question: Which source producer selects an iRules event frame, and can a function label or Registry profile supply that producer?
conclusion: Only the actual Registry-selected lowering of an event declaration retains the conditional event body. The descriptor owns the original body, full source/configuration and Registry content; procedure mapping checks all of those before applying its frame policy. Ordinary function labels cannot select event or hosted storage policy. Cross-event summaries read the retained event identity, and variable diagnostics consume the actual point contexts. The descriptor supplies no reached event, worker, initialization epoch, Normal completion, current value or RULE_INIT broadcast agreement.
scope: Rust implementation contract for conditional source event frames, exact current lowering ownership, function-unit transport and cross-event source analysis. This does not replace independently supplied WorkerExecution, physical variable bindings, observer/lifetime closure or measured appliance publication questions.

tests.assertion: A genuine selected event retains body/source/configuration and the actual conditional point frame, has no worker or seeded value, and summaries use retained event identity even when the report label differs; missing receipt cannot manufacture an event.
An ordinary procedure prefix creates no event descriptor; changed source body/declaration and foreign Registry cannot select the original conditional event frame.

owners.purpose: Retain genuine event lowering body, full original source/configuration and selected Registry; no name label reconstruction or entered execution grant.
Issue the source descriptor only from the independently selected actual event-declaration lowering path.
Authenticate the exact current original procedure body before conditional entry; event units bypass the memo whose input has no event descriptor.
Retain the selected event identity independently of function report names and exact byte-cell execution keys.
Consume actual stored point contexts rather than invent an event entry from labels.

replay.limitations: The named Rust selectors cover source identity, context and negative function-label premises. No executed Rust or native appliance receipt is attached. Independently measured per-TMM mutation and unanswered publication questions retain their existing scope.
